decisions.issues: Only candidate v01 fails the continuity bible. Nagoji's face is right: topknot, grey temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and gold ear stud. The setting is also good: laterite courtyard, squall, men dragging oiled cloth over barrels. But the Goa brand on his left wrist is drawn as a crisp dark-ink ring with a cross inside it. It reads as a tattoo or a cross symbol, while the bible requires a pale puckered patch of raised ridges with no letters and not a cross. He also has a fresh red cut on his left upper arm that is not in the bible, and the long forearm scar is reddish rather than white. Minor: the plan board sits on a raised wooden frame instead of lying in the mud.
decisions.correction: Keep the composition, courtyard, squall, workers, barrels and Nagoji's face, topknot, grey temples, curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, gold ear stud, cream mundu, shoulder cloth and silver chain exactly as they are. Beside it, the only other mark is one long, thin WHITE healed scar running from the wrist toward the elbow. No other marks anywhere on his arms or body: no red cuts, no fresh wounds, no tattoos.
